From the mev builder logs it looks like it's returning the response back to the CL though. Not sure if it's because my machine isn't powerful enough to run it.. Yeah there's one fix mario wanted to make with the mock builder - i think he wasnt sure if it was a cl thing or a mock builder issue. Im gonna try it with lodestar to see what the common factor is 😄 seems like lodestar is able to use the mock mev service: ``` Sep-14 12:53:02.552[] info: Published block slot=25, validator=0xb9e0…5832, graffiti=Lodestar-v1.11.1, source=builder, executionPayloadValue=0.04741 ETH, strictFeeRecipientCheck=false, builderSelection=maxprofit ``` so need to investigate why lighthouse isnt. did you get the `getHeader` from debug logs? kurtosis with docker image `ethpandaops/lodestar:deneb-builder-ddba07e` lemme re-run with debug logs how is this coming in then? slot 25 is still capella ahh lemme check may be somewhere this check is not removed ok i can see it, lemme clean it up and get back parithosh i ve tried running lighthouse lodestar deneb builder tests dumped some block\blobs timings stats from teku-geth https://forkmon.dencun-devnet-8.ethpandaops.io/ devnet-8 doesn't look healthy.
